newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian dollar recovers on domestic buying.
newsitem.headline: Canadian dollar recovers on domestic buying.

text.p: ----------------------MARKET COMMENT-------------------------- * The Canadian dollar partly recovered to C$1.3674 from midday weakness around C$1.3700 (US$0.7299) on domestic corporate buying, but was still off this morning's opening strength near C$1.3643 (US$0.7329), dealers said. * Exporter-driven buying lifted the currency after it had been driven to weakness around C$1.3700 by IMM selling.
On the crosses, Canada's dollar fell to 1.1362 marks from Tuesday's close of 1.1380 marks but rose to 84.29 yen from 83.66 yen.
((Paul Casciato, Reuters Toronto Bureau 416 941-8100 or email: paul.casciato@reuters.com))
